name: entry-hub-monorepo
description: Entry-Hub: Platform for sharing & injecting Entry assets (Web & Chrome Extension)

scripts.package:ext: npm run build:ext && tar.exe -a -c -f entry-hub-extension-v1.0.0.zip -C apps/extension manifest.json dist icons
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:web && npm run build:ext
